entities.name: Scottish Tartan
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: Clan-specific tartan patterns became symbols of Scottish Highland identity. After the Jacobite defeat (1746), the British banned tartan for 36 years — making it a symbol of resistance. Walter Scott's romanticization later made it fashionable worldwide.
